description: Evaluate and dispatch a zero-allocation Taoist Hand Seal / Sutra Codon (e.g. '觀 證 行', 'Kek-01-Seal'). Validates preconditions, computes Kekkai sandbox boundaries, and executes bound Action Skeleton cycles or transmits swarm mudra packet to P2P peer. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

codon.description: Logoglyphic Sutra codon or Taoist hand seal sequence (e.g. '觀 證 行', 'Kek-01-Seal', '根 界 息')

dry_run.description: Alias for !execute; if true, only validates preconditions and returns deterministic plan

execute.description: Whether to execute the bound Action Skeleton against the substrate (default: false / dry-run)

peer.description: Target peer address (e.g. '152.53.195.47:7369') for remote Swarm Mudra Handoff via Wire Protocol 7369

resolves.description: Optional DiAML turn ID resolved by this Sutra execution (defaults to latest open arc when omitted)

session_id.description: Optional session ID to record the executed Sutra DiAML turn into

strict.description: Fails closed if preconditions (read-only, landlock, mesh net) are unsatisfied

track.description: Optional track slug for the recorded Sutra turn

name: sutra.cast
title: Dispatch Sutra / Taoist Mudra
